snippet.title: Side Quest - Trailer English
snippet.description:
Side Quest was Greenlit!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=527592042

Presskit: http://www.mirismind.com/presskits/sheet.php?p=side_quest

Side Quest combines Beat'em Up combat and a fun story about a chef that becomes a hero and sees himself having to fulfill a mission that a very suspicious wizard trusts to him. 
Meanwhile, a young and punchy villain apprentice struggles to keep the hero from finishing this unexpected journey full with action, hordes of enemies and even a legendary knight.
